# Agape Works

> Agape Works is a software development studio based in Udumalpet, Tamil Nadu, India, serving clients in Udumalpet, Coimbatore, Chennai, and worldwide. We build web, mobile, SaaS, AI-powered, and e-commerce software for businesses - fixed scope, the same team from kickoff to launch, weekly working demos, full code ownership handed to the client.

## Facts

- Company name: Agape Works
- Locations: Udumalpet, Coimbatore, and Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (remote-first, works with clients worldwide)
- Contact: studio@agapeworks.in, +91 73739 44336
- Response time: within 1 business day
- "Agape" means selfless, deliberate care - for the product, and for the people it's built with
- Typical engagement: first working version ships in 2-4 weeks, then continues in weekly releases
- The people who scope a project are the same people who build it - no hand-off to a different team
- Clients receive full code ownership and documentation, not just a finished build
- Every engagement runs on a visible weekly cadence, not status reports

## Common questions

### What does Agape Works do?
Agape Works is a software development studio that builds web applications, mobile apps, SaaS
products, AI-powered software, and e-commerce systems for businesses.

### Where is Agape Works located?
Udumalpet, Tamil Nadu, India, serving Udumalpet, Coimbatore, and Chennai, and working remotely
with clients worldwide.

### How long does a project take?
A first working version typically ships in 2 to 4 weeks, after which the project continues in
weekly releases rather than a single hand-off at the end.

### How does Agape Works price work?
Scope is fixed and agreed before a build starts. An instant AI-generated estimate is available at
https://agapeworks.in/scope, and detailed quotes follow a conversation about the actual project.

### Who builds the project?
The same people who scope the project build it. There is no hand-off to a different team after
the pitch, and clients talk directly to the engineers and designers working on their project.

### What happens after launch?
Clients receive full code ownership and documentation so their own team can maintain the work.
Agape Works stays on to measure impact and iterate rather than disappearing at launch.
